manage.lead: Stop the steroid; expect a rebound; treat for weeks.

points: Stop facial steroids and heavy creams; gentle cleanser only.
Oral tetracycline 6–8 weeks if needed (erythromycin if under 12).

items.t: Not responding after 8–12 weeks, granulomatous or periocular disease, diagnostic doubt.

quiz.a: Topical (or inhaled/nasal) corticosteroids on the face.

quiz.q: What is the classic sign around the lips?
quiz.a: A clear rim next to the vermilion (vermilion sparing).
